evidence_examined: PubMed EFetch metadata and abstracts, plus supplied PDF first pages and targeted methods/limitations text where available
quality_score_policy: No numeric score or passed=true until design-specific full-text appraisal and reviewer sign-off

rubric_draft.observational: JBI cohort/cross-sectional domains: participant selection, exposure/outcome measurement, confounding, follow-up or temporal order, analysis and applicability
rubric_draft.prediction: PROBAST domains: participants, predictors, outcome and analysis; separate clinical applicability
rubric_draft.narrative_review: SANRA domains: importance, aims, literature search, referencing, scientific reasoning and data presentation
rubric_draft.systematic_review: AMSTAR 2 critical-domain confidence, not an additive score; verify that a paper is truly a systematic review
rubric_draft.gate: Appropriate topic, publication within 20 years, resolvable DOI/PMID, allowed source class, fresh retraction verification, then design-specific quality review

sources.title: The impact of generalized anxiety disorder and stressful life events on risk for major depressive episodes
sources.reason: Published 2006-03-06, outside the rolling 20-year window on the screening date.

sources.title: The impact of exposure to addictive drugs on future generations: Physiological and behavioral effects
sources.reason: Narrative synthesis on transgenerational drug exposure; much of the evidence is preclinical, limiting direct applicability to human mental-health risk claims.
sources.review_needed: SANRA full-text appraisal and an explicit question linking the preclinical material to the approved topic.

sources.title: Gene x environment interaction studies have not properly controlled for potential confounders
sources.reason: Methodological critique of confounder adjustment, not an estimate of a psychiatric exposure-outcome association.
sources.review_needed: Use only for methods/limitations questions after narrative or methodological appraisal.

sources.title: Polygenic Risk Score, Parental Socioeconomic Status, Family History of Psychiatric Disorders, and the Risk for Schizophrenia
sources.reason: Danish nested case-control analysis (866 cases, 871 controls) directly addresses schizophrenia risk; the separate meta-analysis supplied PRS weights rather than making this a systematic-review evidence tier.
sources.review_needed: JBI case-control/observational appraisal, ancestry and setting generalizability, selection and confounding; document the PubMed Meta-Analysis tag versus primary design.

sources.title: Illusions of controlling the future: Risk and genetic inheritance
sources.reason: The source publication year is 2003, despite a later PubMed processing date; it is also centered on general genetic-risk beliefs rather than the approved mental-health scope.

sources.title: Cognition and Reward Circuits in Schizophrenia: Synergistic, Not Separate
sources.reason: Focused narrative/theoretical review of schizophrenia circuitry; useful for mechanisms but not a primary risk estimate.
sources.review_needed: SANRA appraisal and wording controls against presenting a proposed model as established causation.

sources.title: Predicting mental health problems in adolescence using machine learning techniques
sources.reason: Relevant adolescent prediction study, but its outcome is broad mental-health problems and the authors state that the top model is unsuitable for clinical use.
sources.review_needed: PROBAST appraisal of predictor timing, outcome definition, validation and applicability before any comparison with this project's model.

sources.title: From Basic Science to Clinical Application of Polygenic Risk Scores: A Primer
sources.reason: Broad PRS primer with relevant limitations, but not disorder-specific effect evidence.
sources.review_needed: SANRA appraisal and restriction to explanatory/limitations questions.

sources.title: Environmental Risk Factors for Schizophrenia and Bipolar Disorder and Their Relationship to Genetic Risk
sources.reason: Narrative review directly covers environmental and genetic risk in schizophrenia and bipolar disorder; the PDF appears twice under different filenames.
sources.review_needed: SANRA appraisal, trace support for each asserted exposure association, and retain explicit uncertainty for bipolar-disorder evidence.

sources.title: Association between cannabis use disorder and schizophrenia stronger in young males than in females
sources.reason: Large Danish register cohort directly addresses CUD-schizophrenia association; authors note diagnosed cases only and residual confounding, so attributable fractions are not causal proof.
sources.review_needed: JBI cohort appraisal; examine exposure ascertainment, confounding and sex/age subgroup interpretation.

sources.title: Transcriptomic diversity of cell types across the adult human brain
sources.reason: Healthy-brain cell atlas, not evidence about an approved psychiatric condition or supported association.

sources.title: Adverse Childhood Experiences and Adult Mental Health Outcomes
sources.reason: Swedish twin cohort directly covers abuse/adversity and adult psychiatric outcomes; co-twin design addresses shared familial confounding.
sources.review_needed: JBI cohort appraisal; evaluate retrospective ACE reports, nonshared confounding and cohort generalizability.

sources.title: Adolescent Psychedelic Use and Psychotic or Manic Symptoms
sources.reason: Relevant twin-based adolescent analysis, but exposure and symptoms are cross-sectional and 535 of 541 psychedelic-exposed participants reported other drug use.
sources.review_needed: JBI cross-sectional appraisal; high confounding concern and no causal interpretation; inspect supplement as part of this one publication, not a separate source.

sources.title: Aberrant salience mediates the interplay between emotional abuse and positive symptoms in schizophrenia
sources.reason: Relevant cross-sectional analysis of 222 patients; self-report exposure/mediator and cross-sectional mediation cannot establish causal direction.
sources.review_needed: JBI cross-sectional appraisal; outcome measurement, selection and confounding; restrict causal wording.

sources.title: Connecting genomic results for psychiatric disorders to human brain cell types and regions reveals convergence with functional connectivity
sources.reason: Integrative genomic and imaging analysis is condition-related but mechanistic, not direct evidence of individual risk or clinical prediction.
sources.review_needed: Check GWAS ancestry, sample overlap, multiple testing and replication before mechanisms-only use.

sources.title: How to perform a high-quality peer review
sources.reason: Peer-review methodology, outside the scientific retrieval topic boundary.

sources.title: Genomics of schizophrenia, bipolar disorder and major depressive disorder
sources.reason: Narrative review of the genetics and limitations of three approved psychiatric conditions; not a systematic review or individual risk predictor.
sources.review_needed: SANRA appraisal, provenance of clinical-utility statements, and avoidance of unsupported individualized interpretations.

sources.title: Incorporating genetic data improves target trial emulations and informs the use of polygenic scores in randomized controlled trial design
sources.reason: Its emulated trial outcomes are cardiometabolic, outside the approved psychiatric topic boundary.

sources.title: A survey on deep learning for polygenic risk scores
sources.reason: Broad PRS machine-learning survey, without a specific approved mental-health evidence question.

sources.title: Cross-modal gated feature enhancement for multimodal emotion recognition in conversations
sources.reason: Emotion-recognition benchmark paper, not psychiatric clinical evidence.

sources.title: Biological insights into schizophrenia from ancestrally diverse populations
sources.reason: Schizophrenia genetic association study improves ancestry diversity relative to earlier work; biological associations are not individual-level clinical risk estimates.
sources.review_needed: Assess cohort ascertainment, ancestry transferability, replication and multiple testing before genetics-context use.
